payload.text: 0184 IN BUILD (vc's word, filed at f6a3c02d from dc's and vc's measurements, shellcheck -x peaking at 2.07 to 2.17 GB on bin/devbin): the lint gate sizes its parallel run by CPUs and never by memory, so a host with many CPUs and too little memory has checks killed, each read as a breach. The Fix: a killed or verdict-less file is checked again alone after the parallel run, the second run said, and a status-1 file never run again. Building in scratch on main at b6a39287, where 0180 landed, red there first; if a second run is the wrong shape once in it, vc gets the case.
